title: NABARD Facilitates GI Registration for 28 New Products (Total 176 Supported)
summary: Expands GI tagging for indigenous craft and agri-products across Bihar, Assam, and MP.

blocks.content: Expands GI tagging for indigenous craft and agri-products across Bihar, Assam, and MP.

items: New GI Products: Nalanda Bawanbuti Saree (Bihar), Gaya Pattharkatti Stone Craft (Bihar), Kuchai Silk (Jharkhand), Ba Shilp & Bihu Pepa (Assam), Khajuraho Metal Craft (MP).
NABARD Total: NABARD has supported 176 total products in obtaining GI tags.
